import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    private static final long Mod = 1000000007L;
    private static final double Eps = 1.0e-09;
    private static final double Pi = Math.atan(1.0) * 4.0;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        if (args.length > 1) {
            try {
                scanner = new Scanner(new File(args[1]));
            } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
                System.out.println("File not found: " + args[1]);
            }
        }
        
        while (solve(scanner, System.out, true)) {
            // Continue processing multiple test cases
        }
    }

    private static long fastPow(long a, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        long mask = 1;
        long powPart = a % Mod;
        final int bitsCount = 64;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < bitsCount; i++) {
            if ((p & mask) != 0) {
                res = (res * powPart) % Mod;
            }
            mask <<= 1;
            powPart = (powPart * powPart) % Mod;
        }
        return res;
    }

    private static boolean solve(Scanner ist, OutputStream ost, boolean multipleTestMode) {
        if (!ist.hasNextLong()) {
            return false;
        }
        
        long p = ist.nextLong();
        long k = ist.nextLong();
        
        // Print debug info if in local test mode
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Next test: " + p + " " + k);
        
        if (k == 0) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p - 1);
            PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(ost);
            writer.println(ans);
            writer.flush();
            return multipleTestMode;
        }
        
        if (k == 1) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p);
            PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(ost);
            writer.println(ans);
            writer.flush();
            return multipleTestMode;
        }
        
        long groups = 0;
        boolean[] used = new boolean[(int)(p + 1)];
        long ans = 1;
        
        for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
            if (used[(int)x]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            groups += 1;
            ans = (ans * p) % Mod;
            
            used[(int)x] = true;
            
            long v = x;
            while ((v * k) % p != 0 && !used[(int)((v * k) % p)]) {
                used[(int)((v * k) % p)] = true;
                v = (v * k) % p;
            }
        }
        
        PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(ost);
        writer.println(ans);
        writer.flush();
        return multipleTestMode;
    }
}
